title: Metformin Efficacy in Type 2 Diabetes Prevention
outcome: Metformin significantly reduced progression to type 2 diabetes by 31% in prediabetic adults.

title: Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Metformin in Diabetes Prevention
outcome: After 5 years of follow-up, metformin showed no statistically significant benefit in preventing type 2 diabetes progression compared to placebo in the full population.

title: Aspirin for Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease
outcome: Aspirin reduced the risk of cardiovascular events in adults over 50 with no prior cardiovascular disease.
